data.name: Cloud & AI Solution Engineer
data.jobDescription:
Overview
Join us as a Cloud & AI Solution Engineer helping customers unlock business transformation through Microsoft Cloud. You use your blend of technical depth, architecture thinking, and consultative engagement to shape end‑to‑end solutions that span Azure infrastructure, data, artificial intelligence, security, and modern applications. You lead technical workshops, demonstrations, proof‑of‑concepts, and pilots that give customers confidence in their cloud strategy and path to value.
 
In this role, you partner closely with specialist sellers and account teams to define winning technical strategies, remove deployment blockers, and secure technical decisions. You build trusted relationships with customer technical and business stakeholders, translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and cost‑effective solution architectures, and guide opportunities from technical evaluation through production deployment. You continuously invest in your skills and certifications to maintain technical excellence, while driving operational rigor through accurate opportunity management and clear technical close plans.
